formula: 1 + ceil(printed Strength / 2) + ability premium - unused half-point credit (only for a basic odd-Strength Force with no extra function)
premium_scale: 0 for modest odd-Strength utility or no ability; 1 for significant specialist or even-Strength ability, including basic Guard screening where it materially differentiates 6 Strength
policies: Preserve all printed abilities, classifications, and placement limits.
The core Force function has a fixed 1 Command base cost.
The rounded-up odd-Strength half point supports a modest utility effect; a stronger effect may require +1.
Even-Strength special abilities are normally assessed +1, including meaningful class-native screening.
Keep Bond, Name, Hero, Tactic, Stratagem, Narrative and Order costs unchanged.
Treat these as first-pass physical prices, not measured win-rate balance.
For a completely ability-free odd-Strength basic Force, a 1-Command unused-half-point credit may replace inventing an ability; currently only Thirty Spears.
The four narrow 2-Strength non-attacking supports moved to 3 Strength at the same 3C cost; their minor/conditional abilities now occupy the odd-Strength half-point, without an added premium.

forces.rationale: Plain 5-Strength body; no printed ability. Base cost only.
Raider that removes an attached layer when the opposing Frontline is empty.

3-Strength specialist with narrow conditional utility included in the rounded-up odd-Strength tariff: Conditional healer Action needs another Action and an afflicted Force ahead; +1 printed Strength restores a viable default body without changing the effect or cost.
Guard with persistent Tactic tax when placed in Frontline.
Archer gains Empowered and a conditional Middle-rank Attack target.
Prepared-layer attachment engine can complete Named and grant Guarded.
Two ongoing Maneuver permissions, including while Exhausted.
Odd-Strength budget covers the conditional Bonded mobility.
Skirmisher can raid an attached layer on an Exhausted target (paid ACTION).
Frontline-only Shaken on PLAY can shift a Front by two Strength.
Rear Archer gives persistent Strength to other friendly Archers.
High-Strength Raider can Deplete an unguarded Middle/Rear target.
Frontline Guard grants Guarded to a supporting Force on PLAY.
Odd-Strength budget covers narrow Middle screening despite Shaken.
Raider transfers Command when an opposing Force is Exhausted.
Odd-Strength budget covers Name discount only while Bonded.

3-Strength specialist with narrow conditional utility included in the rounded-up odd-Strength tariff: Middle-only, Named-only Tactic tax against other formations has a late and uncertain trigger; +1 Strength restores a useful default contribution.
Plain 3-Strength Human with no class combat ability or printed effect. Round the unused half-point down to preserve an inexpensive basic deployment.
High-Strength Guard retains Guard-class basic Rear screening; avoids strictly dominating The Fifty Men at equal cost.
Odd-Strength budget covers paid repositioning ACTION.
Odd-Strength budget covers basic Raider Attack; no printed text.
Free on-PLAY movement of a low-Strength Skirmisher.
Odd-Strength budget covers one conditional allied Frontline Move.
Odd-Strength budget covers narrow Frontline Tactic tax on ally behind.

3-Strength specialist with narrow conditional utility included in the rounded-up odd-Strength tariff: Middle-only passive for an already Exhausted and otherwise Maneuver-eligible Force is a rare setup; +1 Strength compensates its narrow floor.
Prepared-layer attachment and +2 completion Strength on PLAY.
Captain/Scout supplies ongoing no-Name Maneuver permission to Force ahead.
Skirmisher can force an opposing Frontline unit toward Rear.

3-Strength specialist with narrow conditional utility included in the rounded-up odd-Strength tariff: One optional reaction to a same-Front hidden Stratagem per Battle is too intermittent for a 2-Strength 3C Force; +1 Strength ensures value without a Stratagem.
Raider can remove an attachment after Frontline opens, through paid ACTION.
Odd-Strength budget covers a conditional row exchange on PLAY.
Odd-Strength budget covers one-position friendly Rear Move.
Odd-Strength budget covers the paid once-per-Battle reconnaissance ACTION.
